verdicts.rationale: Both members share title, DOI, journal, volume 147, and pages 507-516; differ only in author-name formatting and page-dash style. Duplicate import.
Both members identical in title, DOI, journal Visual Cognition, vol 25 no 9-10, pages 841-852; only author formatting and dash differ. Duplicate import.
All three are von Fintel 2008 'What is Presupposition Accommodation, Again?' with the same DOI, journal, vol 22 no 1, pages 137-170. Trailing asterisk and case are extraction artifacts. Same work.
Both members identical in title, DOI, JOCN vol 23 no 1, pages 119-136; only author formatting differs. Duplicate import.
Same edited volume, same DOI and pages 3-17; year 2004 vs 2003 is a copyright/imprint discrepancy already noted in the entry. Only the survivor is indexed. Same work.
All three are Fodor's 'Special Sciences' in Synthese vol 28 no 2, pages 97-115, same DOI. One is mislabeled phdthesis but retains the journal metadata and DOI; clearly the same article. Same work.

All four are Fodor's 'The Language of Thought'. Crowell 1975 is the original; Harvard entries and the 1979-dated one (noted 'Reprint of 1975 edition') are reprints/editions of the same book, same ISBN across reprints. Only the survivor is indexed, so editions collapse to it. Same work.

All six are Fodor's 'Psychosemantics', MIT Press, same ISBN 9780262560528 and (where present) DOI. Year 1989 on one entry is a reprint artifact. No independently indexed member among the losers. Same work.

verdicts.id: a theory of content and other essays
verdicts.rationale: All three members are byte-identical in title, author, year 1990, publisher MIT Press, ISBN 9780585002835. Duplicate imports.
All three members identical: Fodor 'LOT 2', 2008, Clarendon Press, ISBN 9780199548774. Duplicate imports.

All three are Francis, Grosz & Patel-Grosz 'THROW', Glossa vol 8 no 1, same DOI. The loser '-Patel-Grosz' is separately indexed but is the identical paper (same DOI/title/authors) under a malformed citekey, i.e. a genuine duplicate import, not a companion. Same work; merge preserves the survivor's deepIndexed folder.

Both are Friedman's 'Space and Geometry in the B Deduction', 2020, pages 200-228, ISBN 9781107042902. The loser's generic booktitle 'Cambridge University Press eBooks' and slightly different DOI are metadata glitches; identical title, author, pages, and ISBN confirm the same chapter. Same work.
